verdict.rationale: Runpod ships an official open-source CLI (runpodctl) documented extensively for managing Pods, Serverless endpoints, templates, network volumes, and file transfer, confirmed by both docs and a probe hit. It also supports agent-native workflows via MCP servers and agent skills for natural-language control. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of the CLI itself (community evidence only discusses the execution environment, not CLI usage) and no changelog/versioning evidence of active maintenance.
